calculation.description: Rank assets by lagged five-day reversal, increasing reversal exposure during rising VIX and reducing it during falling or stable VIX. VIX is observation-only and is never traded. Signals use only completed prior-day observations.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in every calendar year: 2020 0.05663, 2021 0.05036, 2022 0.11852, 2023 0.02648, 2024 0.08227, 2025 0.01227, 2026 0.04120. Small 15-asset cross-section; uncertainty interpreted conservatively.
